title: NexHub 3.4.0 正式版
body: NexHub 3.4.0 正式版来了！本次主角是桌面卡片：Android 小组件与鸿蒙服务卡片上线，共 8 类——继续观看（显示真实话/集进度与封面）、追更、下载、统计、热力图、大数字、分模块、连续打卡；统计类卡片与 App 统计页同色同构，卡片会跟着系统深浅色自动切换，点一下直达详情页或统计页。可在「设置 → 外观与语言 → 桌面卡片」调背景（封面/主题/纯色）、模糊与条数。同时修复：长列表入场动画断言刷屏、中英混排标题漏译、统计页仍计入隐藏源的记录；设置新增「软件公告」与「联系我们」（GitHub / QQ 群）。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.4.0 (stable) is here! The headline is home-screen widgets: 8 kinds on Android and 10 resizable cards on HarmonyOS — Continue Watching (real episode/chapter progress plus covers), Updates, Downloads, Stats, Heatmap, Big Number, Per-Module and Streak. The stats cards share the app's stats-page look, follow system light/dark automatically, and a tap jumps straight to the detail or stats page. Tune background (cover / theme / solid), blur and item count under Settings → Appearance & Language → Home Widgets. Also fixed: entrance-animation assertion spam on long lists, untranslated mixed Chinese/English titles, and hidden sources still counted in stats; Settings gains Software Announcements and Contact (GitHub / QQ group). No breaking data changes — overwrite-install directly.

title: NexHub 3.3.0 正式版
body: NexHub 3.3.0 正式版来了！本次是翻译与阅读体验的集中升级：小说翻译新增上下文增强、术语闭环（自动提取/冲突裁决）、缓存指纹过期提示、精译模式（三稿合成）与 AI 审校；漫画翻译改为单次优先 + 两阶段兜底，更稳更省；小说阅读器新增多角色朗读（角色卡/AI 分镜/跨章连播）、划词翻译、问 AI、笔记 Markdown 导出、划线笔记云同步、阅读时长趋势图与内置 Edge 语音；鸿蒙端补齐 PC（2in1）适配、跨设备接续、应用分身与后台下载保活。另修复 Bangumi 401 自动续期、详情页长按翻译等一批问题。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.3.0 (stable) is here! A release focused on translation and reading: novel translation gains context enhancement, a terminology loop (auto-extraction / conflict adjudication), cache fingerprints with expiry prompts, a refined mode (three drafts merged) and AI review; manga translation now tries a single pass first with a two-stage fallback — more stable and cheaper; the novel reader adds multi-character TTS (character cards / AI attribution / cross-chapter), selection translation, Ask AI, Markdown note export, highlight cloud sync, reading-time trends and built-in Edge voices; HarmonyOS gains PC (2-in-1) adaptation, cross-device handover, app cloning and background download keep-alive. Also fixes Bangumi 401 auto-refresh and long-press translation issues. No breaking data changes — same signing key, just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 3.2.0 正式版
body: NexHub 3.2.0 正式版来了！鸿蒙（HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony）适配正式落地：arm64 真机完整支持，源解析（含 JS 脚本源）、libmpv 播放与弹幕、画中画、离线朗读、音量键翻页、投屏、莫奈壁纸取色、ECH 加速、图片存相册全部可用。本版还新增 iOS 未签名构建与内置免费翻译（无 AI 配置也能用，Bing 优先、AI 兜底），修复历史记录重启丢失、收藏与下载任务存储稳定性，并恢复投屏与缓存档位对齐。六平台产物统一发布在同一个 Release；鸿蒙 HAP 不带签名，请自行签名后侧载。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.2.0 (stable) is here! HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony support is now official: full arm64 device support with source parsing (including JS-scripted sources), libmpv playback and danmaku, picture-in-picture, offline TTS, volume-key page turning, screen casting, Material You wallpaper colors, ECH acceleration and gallery saving. This release also adds an unsigned iOS build and built-in free translation (works without any AI setup — free channel first, AI fallback), fixes history loss after restart and storage stability for favorites / download tasks, and restores casting plus buffer-tier alignment. All six platforms ship in a single Release; the HarmonyOS HAP is unsigned — sign it yourself and sideload. No breaking data changes — same signing key, just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 3.1.0 正式版
body: NexHub 3.1.0 正式版来了！基础功能完整、可安全升级。播放器大升级：暂停时可逐帧步进（桌面逗号/句号快捷键）、起播自动全屏、播放失败页新增返回栏；视频嗅探候选排序选优防广告冒充，无头嗅探接入网络层被动捕获，部分站点精品线路真链捕获修复；搜索热词接入实时榜单并支持长按删除，源搜索改为回车提交；修复历史封面丢失、测速时无法下载新版本，Windows 安装包补齐 ECH 引擎 DLL（本版起 Windows ECH 真正可用）。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.1.0 (stable) is here! Solid and safe to upgrade. Player upgrades: frame-by-frame stepping while paused (comma/period on desktop), auto-fullscreen on playback start, and a back bar on playback error pages; video sniffing now ranks candidates to keep ads from crowding out real links, passive network-layer capture covers iframe/Worker blind spots, and premium-line real-link capture is fixed on some sites; search hot words now come from a live ranking with long-press to delete, and source search submits on Enter; fixes history cover loss, update download stuck during speed tests, and the Windows installer now bundles the ECH engine DLL (ECH works on Windows from this build). No breaking data changes — same signing key, just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 3.0.0 正式版
body: NexHub 3.0.0 正式版来了！这是 3.0.0 测试线的稳定收口，基础功能完整、可安全升级。一次性带来全新 Material 3 视觉体系、媒体服务器（Emby / Jellyfin）、ECH 加密握手（Android 三架构 + Windows 桌面端生效）、源编辑五页签重构、三大阅读器增强与漫画动态效果；本轮还大批量加固了网络连通性（请求头保真规避 WAF 指纹、403 换 IP 丢连接池、SNI 清空不再被丢弃、CF 边缘限制修复）与抓取解析健壮性，并补上一批源回归测试。从 2.0.3 升级的用户将获得完整 3.0.0 能力。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.0.0 (stable) is here! This is the stabilized endpoint of the 3.0.0 test line — solid and safe to upgrade. It lands the full Material 3 design system, media servers (Emby / Jellyfin), ECH encrypted handshake (shipped on Android three ABIs + Windows desktop), the five-tab source editor rewrite, three-reader enhancements and comic dynamic effects; this round also hardens connectivity in bulk (header-case preservation against WAF fingerprinting, connection-pool drop on 403 IP-rotation, SNI-clear no longer silently dropped, Cloudflare edge-limit fixes) and parser robustness, plus a batch of source regression tests. Users upgrading from 2.0.3 get the complete 3.0.0 capability set. No breaking data changes — same signing key, just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.4 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.4 预发布测试版来了！本次聚焦网络链路加固与细节打磨：ECH 加密握手引擎完成多平台化——现已随 Android（arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86_64 三架构）与 Windows 桌面端打包生效，Bangumi 的 ECH 并入连接模式三选一，macOS / Linux 暂未打包原生库自动降级为直连；源内置 hosts 真正接入 WebView / 嗅探 / 下载并补多 IP 故障转移，Android WebView 跟随静态代理规则、Windows WebView2 修好此前从未生效的 DIRECT 兜底。界面上源编辑页拆分为「基本信息 / 网络 / 解析 / 筛选 / 高级」五页签、筛选面板分组折叠懒加载；Android 刘海屏沉浸全屏黑边修复；应用内更新弹窗不再截断发布说明、自建轻量 markdown 渲染器。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.4 (pre-release beta) is here! This round hardens the network stack and polishes details: the ECH encrypted-handshake engine is now multi-platform — shipped with Android (arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86_64) and the Windows desktop build, with Bangumi's ECH folded into the unified three-mode connection switch; macOS / Linux fall back to direct automatically for now. Source-declared hosts now truly reach the WebView / sniffer / download paths with multi-IP failover; Android WebView follows the static proxy rules and the Windows WebView2 DIRECT fallback (previously broken) is fixed. On UI: the source editor splits into five tabs (Basic / Network / Parser / Filter / Advanced) and the filter panel folds + lazy-loads; the Android notch immersive-fullscreen black bar is fixed; and the in-app update dialog no longer truncates the release notes thanks to a lightweight built-in markdown renderer. No breaking data changes — same signing key, just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.3 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.3 预发布测试版来了！本次聚焦界面个性化与网络连通：新增全局字体设置（跟随系统 / 三款内置 OFL 字体 / 自定义导入）与详情页外观设置（封面动态强调色 + 封面模糊背景）；在线浏览换源改为标题底部弹窗、源列表统一连体卡并支持拖拽排序、嗅探结果面板高度可拖拽。网络方面，此前预留的 ECH 加密握手现已实装可用——原生引擎驱动、应用级 / 源级 / Bangumi 三档作用域、直连 HTTPS 生效，非 Android 自动降级。媒体服务器新增海报分辨率自适应、合集浏览与统计维度；部分受 Cloudflare 保护的动漫源工程化修复。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.3 (pre-release beta) is here! This round focuses on UI personalization and connectivity: a new global font setting (follow system / three built-in OFL fonts / custom import) and detail-page appearance (cover-driven accent color + blurred cover backdrop); online source-switching moves to a bottom-sheet, the source list gets unified cards with drag-to-reorder, and the sniffer result panel is height-draggable. On the network side, the previously reserved ECH encrypted handshake now actually works: native-engine driven, app-level / per-source / Bangumi scopes, effective for direct HTTPS, auto-degrading off Android. Media servers gain density-aware posters, collection browsing and stats; a Cloudflare-protected anime source family is engineering-hardened. No breaking data changes, same signing key, just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.2 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.2 预发布测试版来了，国庆快乐！🇨🇳 本次核心：接入你自建的媒体服务器（Emby / Jellyfin）——浏览、搜索、播放、收藏、进度全打通，多地址自动切换 + 前台探活，播放前自动在原画直连 / 直接播放 / 服务端转码间决策，收藏与进度双向同步；漫画新增图片超分（多档位，低分辨率图片自动显现入口）与缓存分类自动清理；修复 WebDAV PROPFIND 解析、Android 导航条透明与手势条避让。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。🇨🇳 山河远阔，假期愉快，追番读漫看片两不误！
bodyEn: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.2 (pre-release beta) is here — happy National Day! 🇨🇳 Highlights: connect your self-hosted media server (Emby / Jellyfin) — browse, search, play, favorites and progress all wired up, with multi-address failover + foreground keep-alive, automatic direct-stream / transcode decisions before playback, and two-way favorite & progress sync; manga gains image super-resolution (multi-tier, surfaced automatically for low-res images) and category-based auto cache cleanup; fixes for WebDAV PROPFIND parsing, Android nav-bar transparency and gesture-bar insets. No breaking data changes — same signing key, just overwrite-install. 🇨🇳 Enjoy the holidays and your anime, manga and movies!

title: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.1 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.1 预发布测试版来了！这是一次大版本跨越：全应用搬到 Material 3 设计系统（全动态取色 + 9 种调色板风格）、侧栏/底栏毛玻璃、本地/网络导入独立预览页；并新增漫画动态效果（分层动效引擎，让静态漫画页拥有视差/呼吸/天气/光效等表现，阅读器内可开关调节）。底层完成 material_ui 1.4.0 迁移与 dynamic_color 解钉，弃用 API 全量迁移。🌟 特别感谢 mobai0z0 贡献了漫画动态效果。⚠️ 漫画动态效果仍在打磨中、部分机型可能不稳定，后续版本会继续优化。无破坏性数据变更，沿用同一签名密钥可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 3.0.0-beta.1 (pre-release beta) is here! This is a major step: the whole UI moves to the Material 3 design system (fully dynamic color + 9 palette styles), with frosted side/top bars and a standalone local/network import preview page; plus brand-new comic dynamic effects (a layered-motion engine that brings static pages to life with parallax/breathing/weather/light, toggleable and tunable in the reader). Under the hood: material_ui 1.4.0 migration and dynamic_color unpinning, with deprecated APIs fully migrated. 🌟 Special thanks to mobai0z0 for the comic dynamic effects. ⚠️ The comic motion effects are still a work in progress and may be unstable on some devices; more polish is coming. No breaking data changes — same signing key, just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.3 正式版
body: NexHub 2.0.3 正式版来了！它建立在 2.0.2 正式版之上，基础功能完整、可安全升级，本次聚焦引擎健壮性、MD3 官方触感反馈与下载/界面稳定性：JS 沙箱预置 atob/btoa，源脚本可直接调用、无需内嵌 polyfill，meta 多跳解析更稳；震动反馈按 Material 3 官方语义重构，开关/滑块/单选/下拉刷新/长按约 200 处统一映射；修复 SAF 下载 .cbz 扩展名改写失败、切 tab 入场动画重播崩溃，年龄限制开启时书架历史自动隐藏 R18 条目。沿用同一签名密钥，可直接覆盖安装。🌕 中秋快乐！月圆人安，愿你追番读漫皆顺心。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.3 (stable) is here! Built on 2.0.2 (stable), it's solid and safe to upgrade. This release focuses on engine robustness, MD3 haptics, and download/UI stability: the JS sandbox now presets atob/btoa so source scripts can call them directly without embedding a polyfill, and meta multi-hop parsing is more stable; vibration feedback follows the Material 3 official semantics, with ~200 call sites (toggles/sliders/radios/refresh/long-press) uniformly mapped; SAF .cbz extension-rewrite download failures and the tab-switch entrance-animation replay crash are fixed, and the bookshelf history auto-hides R18 entries when age restriction is on. Same signing key — just overwrite-install. 🌕 Happy Mid-Autumn! May the full moon bring peace, and may your anime, manga and reading all go smoothly.

title: NexHub 2.0.2 正式版
body: NexHub 2.0.2 正式版来了！它建立在 2.0.1 正式版之上，基础功能完整、可安全升级，本次聚焦下载 / 更新通道可靠性与图片保存、分享体验：应用内更新下载完成后做三重校验（流截断 / 字节数比对 / 文件头魔数），坏包自动换镜像重下，杜绝「无法解压」坏包被静默交付；Android 高版本下载路径修复，存储不可用时回落应用私有目录；漫画 / RSS 长按「保存」经系统相册落地（Android 10+ 免权限），「分享」改为系统面板真分享图片文件；全局列表弹窗去阴影加圆角。沿用同一签名密钥，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.2 (stable) is here! Built on 2.0.1 (stable), it's solid and safe to upgrade. This release focuses on download/update reliability and image save/share: in-app updates now run triple integrity checks (stream truncation / byte count / file magic) after download, auto-switching mirrors on a bad package so 'cannot parse' broken installs are never silently delivered; Android high-version download paths fall back to the app's private directory when storage is unavailable; manga/RSS long-press 'Save' lands in the system gallery (no permission on Android 10+), and 'Share' now truly shares the image file via the system panel; global sheet/menu popups lose their shadow and gain rounded corners. Same signing key — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.1 正式版
body: NexHub 2.0.1 正式版来了！它建立在 2.0.0 正式版之上，基础功能完整、可安全升级，本次聚焦源解析健壮性、网络收藏脚本通道与视频解析稳定性：路由占位符支持数值运算（{page-1} / {page*30-30}），0 基分页与 JSON API 的 offset 分页都能在 URL 里一次算好；网络收藏新增「脚本通道」——收藏列表与加入收藏均可走源脚本端点，支持多步请求与登录令牌注入，适配需鉴权的 App API 类源站；详情/选集链接修正 {detailUrl} 直通与同源 http→https 升级；视频解析脚本型路由优先确定性解析，省去最长 12s 嗅探并避开 Windows 内嵌浏览器崩溃区。沿用同一签名密钥，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.1 (stable) is here! Built on 2.0.0 (stable), it's solid and safe to upgrade. This release focuses on source-parsing robustness, the web-favorites script channel, and video-resolution stability: route placeholders now support numeric arithmetic ({page-1} / {page*30-30}) so both 0-based and JSON-API offset pagination can be computed directly in the URL; web favorites gain a 'script channel' — both the favorites list and the add-to-favorites action can run through a source script endpoint with multi-step requests and login-token injection, fitting auth-required App API sources; detail/episode links get {detailUrl} pass-through and same-host http→https upgrade; video resolution prefers a deterministic script path, dropping the up-to-12s sniffing wait and avoiding the Windows embedded-browser crash zone. Same signing key — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0 正式版
body: NexHub 2.0.0 正式版来了！经过 beta.1 → beta.8 八轮打磨，基础功能完整、可安全升级：底层与三大阅读器、RSS 订阅、网络配置、源解析能力都已充分验证。本次正式版相较 beta.8 还新增了「源声明式图片字节解密 imageTransform」（部分图床对图片字节本身加密，现在源可在 imageTransform 段声明解密方式，引擎统一解密，支持 aes-cbc/aes-ecb/rc4/xor 等）、章节页 Referer 推导取图、图片收藏本地缓存、通用渲染与图片兼容增强、抓取层 JSON 协商、Cookie 轮换站点图片修复、启动回填本地封面崩溃修复。沿用同一签名密钥，可直接覆盖安装。另外想跟大家说一声：过去两三个月我几乎每天高强度开发（常一天十小时以上），现在有点累了，想先休息一段时间；NexHub 不会停更，后续我仍会持续维护（修 bug、保稳定），只是功能上可能不会有大的新增，节奏会慢一些。感谢一路的陪伴。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0 (stable) is here! After eight beta rounds (beta.1 → beta.8), the foundation is solid and safe to upgrade: the engine, the three readers, RSS, network config and source parsing are all well exercised. Compared to beta.8, this stable build also adds source-declared image-byte decryption (imageTransform — for CDNs that encrypt the image bytes themselves, sources can now declare the decryption in an imageTransform block and the engine decrypts uniformly, supporting aes-cbc/aes-ecb/rc4/xor), Referer-derived image fetch on chapter pages, local caching for image favorites, broader rendering/image compatibility, JSON negotiation in the fetch layer, a fix for image-flip-flopping on cookie-rotation sites, and a startup crash fix when restoring local covers. Same signing key — just overwrite-install. A note from the author: after two to three months of near-daily, high-intensity development (often ten-plus hours a day), I'm a bit tired and want to take a break for a while. NexHub is not abandoned — I'll keep maintaining it (bug fixes, stability), but feature growth may slow down for a bit. Thanks for all the company along the way.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.8 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.8 预发布测试版来了！本次集中打磨界面手感：新增统一的微交互动画（卡片划入、数值脉冲、刷新指示器等），整体偏小字号、收紧间距；首页 / 分类支持滑动切换导航，源列表去掉冗余 URL 行、在线浏览的搜索与筛选对齐、RSS 顶栏恢复。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。另外想跟大家说一声：过去两三个月我几乎每天高强度开发（常一天十小时以上），现在有点累了，想先休息一段时间；NexHub 不会停更，后续我仍会持续维护（修 bug、保稳定），只是功能上可能不会有大的新增，节奏会慢一些。感谢一路的陪伴。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.8 (pre-release beta) is here! This release focuses on UI and interaction polish: unified micro-interaction animations (card slide-in, value pulse, refresh indicator), smaller fonts and tighter spacing; swipe-to-switch navigation on home/categories, a cleaner source list (redundant URL row removed), symmetric search/filter in the online browser, and the RSS top bar restored. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install. A note from the author: after two to three months of near-daily, high-intensity development (often ten-plus hours a day), I'm a bit tired and want to take a break for a while. NexHub is not abandoned — I'll keep maintaining it (bug fixes, stability), but feature growth may slow down for a bit. Thanks for all the company along the way.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.7 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.7 预发布测试版来了！本次是一次小而关键的修复：解决「应用内更新提示下载完成、装上的却是旧版本安装包」的问题——现在安装包按版本号分目录存放，旧残留不会再冒充新包；复用本地包前会先校验文件完整性，旧版本残留也会自动清理。如果你之前遇到过「明明更新了，版本号却没变」，这一版请手动下载安装一次，之后的应用内更新就恢复正常了。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.7 (pre-release beta) is here! A small but critical fix: resolves 'in-app update says download complete but installs the old package' — installers are now stored in per-version folders so stale files can no longer pose as the new package; local files are integrity-checked before reuse, and leftovers from previous versions are cleaned up automatically. If you ever updated but the version number didn't change, please manually install this one — after that, in-app updates work normally again. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.6 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.6 预发布测试版来了！本次把 RSS 订阅从「一个简单的列表」升级为完整的阅读模块：离线缓存（含正文，断网可读）+ 全文抓取、已读置灰与跨源收藏页、分组管理与 OPML 导入导出、输入网址自动发现订阅、单源与全局跨源搜索；文章里图片可点开进画廊缩放保存，视频直接内嵌播放（手势 / 锁屏 / 比例 / 进度记忆与主播放器一致），带音频的播客源可直接播放。还修好了图片 403 加载失败、音频显示 0:00、抓取超时、内嵌视频偶发连不上等实机问题，并支持条件 GET 省流量、非 UTF-8 订阅不再乱码，DNS 解析出多个 IP 时逐个重试（修复「浏览器能开、应用超时」）。更新提醒新增系统通知开关与充电时自动检测。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.6 (pre-release beta) is here! RSS subscription grows from a simple list into a full reading module: offline caching (full text included, readable without network) + full-text fetch, read-state dimming and a cross-source favorites page, group management with OPML import/export, feed auto-discovery from a site URL, and per-feed plus global cross-feed search. Images in articles open into a pannable/zoomable gallery with save and share, videos play inline (gestures / control lock / aspect ratio / progress memory, matching the main player), and podcast feeds with audio enclosures play right on the article page. Real-device fixes land too: image 403 failures, audio showing 0:00, fetch timeouts and flaky inline video. Conditional GET saves traffic, non-UTF-8 feeds no longer garble, and DNS results with multiple IPs are tried in order (fixing 'browser opens it, app times out'). Update reminders gain a system-notification toggle and a while-charging check. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.5 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.5 预发布测试版来了！本次集中修复网络收藏的多文件夹体验与源网络档案覆盖范围：网络收藏现在能正确切换文件夹、两级导航（文件夹→作品）不再卡死，文件夹卡片还显示条目数；评论、标签浏览、收藏列表三处现在也会正确应用你在源里配置的 SNI / 钉 IP / 自定义 DNS，之前这些页面因没走源网络配置而连不上的问题已修复。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.5 (pre-release beta) is here! This release fixes the multi-folder web-favorite experience and broadens source network-profile coverage: web favorites now switch folders correctly and the two-level navigation (folders → items) no longer gets stuck, and folder cards show item counts; comments, tag browsing and favorite lists now correctly apply the SNI / pinned-IP / custom-DNS you configured in the source — the connection failures on those pages are fixed. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.4 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.4 预发布测试版来了！本次重点打磨跨语言翻译的可靠性与可用性：翻译接口主备容灾 + 健康熔断，章节翻译支持断点续译，术语表注入让专有名词翻译一致，可选润色与证据审校，译文可一键导出复用；漫画页翻译气泡回填更准、视频整片字幕离线翻译可导出双语字幕。同时加固网络连通性（同站串行防限流、网络收藏修复、Cookie 登录归一化）、收藏（详情页可收藏 + 图片收藏持久化）、下载与更新通道，并默认隐藏 18+ 源、全应用补齐触感反馈。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.4 (pre-release beta) is here! This release hardens cross-language translation reliability and usability: primary/backup translation endpoints with a health circuit breaker, resumable chapter translation via checkpoints, glossary injection for consistent terms, optional polish and evidence-driven review, and one-tap export of reusable translations; manga page-translation bubbles backfill more accurately and whole-video offline subtitle translation can export bilingual subtitles. Network connectivity is further hardened (per-host serialization to avoid rate-limiting, web-favorite fixes, normalized cookie login), favorites (detail-page favorite + image-favorite persistence), download and update channels, plus 18+ sources hidden by default and haptic feedback app-wide. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.3 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.3 预发布测试版来了！本次重点带来两大跨语言阅读能力：漫画页翻译（翻页自动对当前页做 OCR + 翻译，译文按版面叠加、按作品记忆、失败可重试）与视频字幕实时翻译（字幕面板开关逐句翻译、无字幕时截帧画面 OCR 兜底、译文覆盖层可选显示原文）。同时修复了更新通道——测试版通道现在能正确识别新版本，并支持 alpha / beta / rc 预发布逐级升级；大幅增强网络连通性：运行时 SNI 控制（免 SNI 绕封锁）、DNS 解析后缀（社区源不含 IP）、源级网络覆盖自动沿用、无头抓取接入 Cloudflare 验证与直连 TLS / 端口修复；源解析能力增强：路由占位符偏移 {page-1}/{page+1}、meta 批量预取、分类键名容错。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.3 (pre-release beta) is here! Two cross-language reading capabilities headline this release: manga page translation (auto OCR + translate on page-turn, layout-overlaid bubbles, per-work memory, retry on failure) and real-time video subtitle translation (per-sentence panel toggle, frame OCR fallback when no subtitle, optional original overlay). The update channel is fixed — the beta channel now detects new versions and supports alpha / beta / rc pre-release upgrades; network connectivity is greatly improved with runtime SNI control (SNI-free to bypass blocking), DNS resolve suffixes (no IPs in community sources), auto-inherited source network overrides, headless Cloudflare handling and direct TLS / port fixes; source parsing is enhanced with route placeholder offsets {page-1}/{page+1}, meta batch prefetch and category key tolerance. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.2 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.2 预发布测试版来了！在 beta.1 基础上继续打磨三大阅读器：小说阅读器新增双页模式、整本页码、AI 双语 / 段落翻译、AI 章节配图、阅读器内正文编辑、墨水屏主题、压缩包批量导入、Mobi / PDF 解析、阅读进度 WebDAV 云同步、EPUB 导出模板、划线 / 高亮 / 摘录 / 分享；漫画阅读器新增夜览暖色盖层、睡眠定时、资源内存优化、双击三态、E-Ink 刷新、ICC 校色、预加载 1–16；影视播放器新增 Anime4K 超分辨率、弹幕发送、缓存降级、错误重试、字幕记忆、系统画中画与投屏完整生命周期；还有跨作品待读队列、统一图片收藏图库、源 API Key 登录与 WebView 登录 + Cookie 回灌、Cloudflare 验证修复，以及大量实机修复。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.2 (pre-release beta) is here! Building on beta.1, the three readers are further polished: the novel reader gains dual-page mode, whole-book page numbers, AI bilingual / paragraph translation, AI chapter illustration, in-reader text editing, e-ink theme, batch archive import, Mobi / PDF parsing, fine-grained WebDAV reading-progress sync, EPUB export templates, and highlight / annotate / share; the manga reader adds night-light overlay, sleep timer, resource & memory optimization, double-tap 3-state, E-Ink refresh, ICC color, and 1–16 preload; the video player adds Anime4K super-resolution, danmaku sending, cache degrade, error retry, subtitle memory, and full system-PiP / cast lifecycle; plus a cross-work reading queue, unified image gallery, source API-Key login with WebView login + cookie injection, Cloudflare fix, and many real-device fixes. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.1 预发布测试版
body: 2.0.0 预发布测试版来了！底层升级到 Flutter 3.47；小说阅读器新增 Legado（阅读）书源导入兼容、书内搜索跳命中、阅读总结、音量键 / 滚轮翻页、TXT 内部章节细化、进度恢复修正、GBK 乱码修复；漫画阅读器新增书签、图片收藏、自然排序、自动下载、缩放倍数指示等大批实机修复；影视播放器新增多源自动选源 + 故障回退、跨作品播放队列、后台播放 + 通知栏、画中画、跳过片头片尾、自动连播倒计时、睡眠按集数、双击 seek 累加、底部细进度条、弹幕去重、本地视频封面、横滑取消手势等。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: The 2.0.0 pre-release beta is here! Flutter upgraded to 3.47; the novel reader gains Legado (阅读) source import, in-book search jump, reading summary, volume-key / wheel page-turn, TXT chapter splitting, progress-restore fix and GBK mojibake fix; the manga reader adds bookmarks, image collection, natural sort, auto-download, zoom-ratio indicator and many real-device fixes; the video player adds multi-source auto-select with failover, cross-work play queue, background playback + notification, PiP, intro/outro skip, auto-next countdown, sleep-by-episodes, double-tap seek accumulation, bottom thin progress bar, danmaku dedupe, local video cover and swipe-cancel gesture. title: NexHub 1.2.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：重点修复本地内容（下载 / 导入）稳定性——Android SAF 下载写入、本地下载视频 / 漫画 / 小说打开、下载落盘丢失章节等问题；三大阅读器体验增强（小说大文件加载提速、EPUB 章节解析更准）；新增「运行日志」（设置 → 高级）便于反馈排障。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖升级。
bodyEn: This update focuses on local content (download / import) stability: Android SAF write, opening locally downloaded video / manga / novel, and lost chapters on download are fixed; the three readers are improved (faster large-file loading, more accurate EPUB chapter splitting); a new Run Log (Settings → Advanced) makes bug reports easier. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 1.1.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：新增本地内容导入体系——小说支持 TXT / EPUB，漫画支持 PDF / CBR / RAR / 7Z 等归档与整文件夹导入（Android 支持 SAF 文件夹）；设置搜索升级为 226 项全覆盖、直达具体设置项。无破坏性数据变更，旧数据与源 JSON 无需重新导入，可直接覆盖升级。
bodyEn: This update adds a full local content import pipeline: novels in TXT / EPUB, manga from PDF, CBR, RAR, 7Z archives or whole folders (Android SAF supported), plus a settings search that covers all 226 entries and jumps straight to the exact setting. No breaking data changes — your data and source JSON need no re-import; just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 1.0.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：首次启动 6 步新手引导、软件公告系统、Bangumi OAuth 登录重写修复（授权返回不再卡死转圈）。基础功能已完成，数据格式保持兼容，可放心升级。应用不内置任何站点，内容来自你导入的源。
bodyEn: This update: a 6-step onboarding guide, an in-app announcement system, and a rewritten Bangumi OAuth login (no more stuck spinner on return). Core features are complete and data stays compatible — safe to upgrade. The app ships no built-in sites; content comes from the sources you import.

title: NexHub 0.5.1 发布
body: 本次更新：软件公告与首次启动引导、Bangumi 登录改用内置浏览器、语言默认跟随系统。应用不内置任何站点，内容来自你导入的源。
bodyEn: This update: in-app announcements and first-launch onboarding, Bangumi sign-in now uses an embedded browser, and language defaults to following the system. The app ships no built-in sites; content comes from the sources you import.

title: 欢迎使用 NexHub
body: NexHub 是四合一媒体聚合客户端（动漫 / 漫画 / 小说 / 影视）。它不内置任何站点，解析能力全部来自可导入的「源」。导入社区维护的源后即可开始浏览。
bodyEn: NexHub is an all-in-one media client (anime / manga / novel / video). It ships no built-in sites; all parsing comes from importable 'sources'. Import a community-maintained source to start browsing.
